name: Unity project location
goalName: How to fix "Failed to resolve project template: Failed to decompress [path]"?
goal: When creating a unity project (setup as Universal Render Pipeline) Unity gives an error and creates an invalid project.

approach.text: <<source “Failed to resolve project template: Failed to decompress.” (2017, May 23). Unity Forum. https://forum.unity.com/threads/failed-to-resolve-project-template-failed-to-decompress.663214/>>

result: Even though teachers said the issue wasn't the path, it turned out to be the path length. As I created projects in folders containing spaces and other special symbols, which worked, I tested the length of the path by creating a folder "Suuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuper long name". As expected, this gave me the same error seen below:<<image 6.png>>
validation: After I found the source of the problem, I asked teachers if my conclusion was correct.
contribution: Now I know about the limitation of path lengths, I will restructure the folders on my computer, having an 'Active' directory at the (near) root of the system, and a 'backup' folder structure for finished projects.
